mapper.sql: SELECT a.id, a.customer_id, a.service_id, a.therapist_id, a.appointment_time, a.end_time, a.status, a.note, a.created_at, a.updated_at, c.name AS customer_name, s.name AS service_name, u.display_name AS therapist_name FROM appointments a LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = a.customer_id LEFT JOIN services s ON s.id = a.service_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.therapist_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appointments (customer_id, service_id, therapist_id, appointment_time, end_time, status, note, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{serviceId}, #{therapistId}, #{appointmentTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{note}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE appointments SET customer_id = #{customerId}, service_id = #{serviceId}, therapist_id = #{therapistId}, appointment_time = #{appointmentTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, note = #{note}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE appointments SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM appointments WHERE therapist_id = #{therapistId} AND status = 'BOOKED'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM appointments WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND status = 'BOOKED'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM appointments WHERE service_id = #{serviceId} AND status = 'BOOKED'
